import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (main plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0:2, 0:2])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Price by Brand (top brands)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_avg = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
colors_bar = sns.color_palette('viridis', n_colors=len(brand_avg))
ax2.barh(range(len(brand_avg)), brand_avg.values, color=colors_bar)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(brand_avg)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(brand_avg.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Brands by Avg Price', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. 4K Video Capability Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(video_4k_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 4. Camera Weight Distribution by Body Type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0:2])
body_types = df['body_type'].value_counts().head(4).index
data_violin = [df[df['body_type'] == bt]['weight_grams'].values for bt in body_types]
parts = ax4.violinplot(data_violin, positions=range(len(body_types)), 
                       showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for pc in parts['bodies']:
    pc.set_facecolor(sns.color_palette('muted')[0])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(body_types)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(body_types, fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 5. Model Year vs Max ISO trend
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
year_iso = df.groupby('model_year')['max_iso'].agg(['mean', 'median'])
ax5.plot(year_iso.index, year_iso['mean'], marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=5, label='Mean', color='#E74C3C')
ax5.plot(year_iso.index, year_iso['median'], marker='s', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=5, label='Median', color='#3498DB')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Max ISO Over Years', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.legend(fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
